title: Stored Procedure — Get Employees by Department
description: Create a stored procedure that accepts a department name and returns employees in that department.

data.text: Write a stored procedure named `sp_GetEmployeesByDepartment` that accepts a department name parameter and returns all employees in that department.

data.title: SQL Solution
Explanation
data.text: Stored procedures are precompiled SQL routines stored in the database. Parameters use @ prefix. SET NOCOUNT ON prevents the 'N rows affected' message from interfering with result sets. Always prefix procedures with sp_ to follow SQL Server naming conventions (or use a custom schema prefix).
